questions.question: Which of the following sexually transmitted diseases is transmitted by a virus?

__
 
• **AIDS** is a sexually transmitted disease caused by the **Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)**.
 
• HIV attacks the body's immune system, specifically the CD4 cells (T cells), which are crucial for immune defense.
 
• Without treatment, HIV reduces the number of T cells in the body, making the person more likely to get infections or infection-related cancers.
 
• Over time, HIV can destroy so many of these cells that the body can't fight off infections and disease, leading to the most severe phase of HIV infection, known as AIDS.

• **Common cold** is caused by various viruses, predominantly rhinoviruses, but it is not considered a sexually transmitted disease.
 
• Preventive measures for HIV/AIDS include safe sex practices, regular testing, and the use of antiretroviral therapy (ART) for those infected.

questions.question: Which of the following sequences of events occurs during the formation of urine in the human body?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the formation of urine in the human body, the sequence of events is **filtration, reabsorption, and secretion**.
 
• Filtration occurs in the **glomerulus**, where blood pressure forces water and solutes out of the blood and into the renal tubule.
 
• Reabsorption is the process where necessary substances and water are reabsorbed back into the blood from the renal tubules.
 
• Secretion involves the addition of waste products and other substances from the blood into the renal tubule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The kidneys play a crucial role in maintaining homeostasis by regulating the volume and composition of body fluids.
 
• The nephron is the functional unit of the kidney, consisting of the glomerulus and renal tubule.
 
• After filtration, the filtrate passes through the proximal tubule, loop of Henle, distal tubule, and collecting duct, where reabsorption and secretion occur.
 
• The final product, urine, is collected in the renal pelvis and transported to the bladder for excretion.

(A) Convex lens

(B) Concave lens

(C) Concave mirror

(D) Convex mirror
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

To produce a parallel beam of rays from a point source of light, we need optical devices that can convert diverging rays from the point source into parallel rays. The following points explain why:

__
 
• **Convex Lens:** A convex lens can converge light rays from a point source to form a parallel beam if the point source is placed at its focal point. The rays emerging from the other side of the lens will be parallel to the principal axis.
 
• **Concave Mirror:** A concave mirror can also produce a parallel beam of rays if the point source is placed at its focal point. The reflected rays will be parallel to the principal axis.

**Why not the other options?**

 
• **Concave Lens:** A concave lens diverges light rays and cannot produce a parallel beam from a point source.
 
• **Convex Mirror:** A convex mirror also diverges light rays, making it unable to produce a parallel beam from a point source.

Therefore, the correct combination of optical devices that can produce a parallel beam of rays from a point source is both a convex lens and a concave mirror, which corresponds to **Option 2**__.

questions.question: If the surface area of a spherical ball is 616 m2, its volume is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Surface area of the spherical ball = 616 m²

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the sphere be r meters.

Surface area = 4πr²

⇒ 4πr² = 616

⇒ r² = 616 / (4π)

⇒ r² = 616 / (4 × 3.14)

⇒ r² = 616 / 12.56

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = √49

⇒ r = 7 meters

Now, Volume = (4/3)πr³

⇒ Volume = (4/3)π × 7³

⇒ Volume = (4/3)π × 343

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 3.14 × 343

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 1077.02

⇒ Volume = 1436.03 m³

**The volume of the spherical ball is approximately 1437.33 m³.**

questions.question: I walk at a speed of 10 km/h and reach the destination in 2 hrs. If I increase my speed by 5 km/h, how early would I reach my destination?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Speed = 10 km/h

Time taken at initial speed = 2 hrs

Increased Speed = 10 km/h + 5 km/h = 15 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

Time Difference = Initial Time - New Time

**Calculation:**

Distance travelled = Initial Speed × Initial Time

⇒ Distance = 10 km/h × 2 hrs

⇒ Distance = 20 km

New Time = Distance / Increased Speed

⇒ New Time = 20 km / 15 km/h

⇒ New Time = (20)/(15) hrs

⇒ New Time = 4/3 hrs

⇒ New Time = 1 hr 20 min

Time Difference = Initial Time - New Time

⇒ Time Difference = 2 hrs - 1 hr 20 min

⇒ Time Difference = 40 min

**The correct answer is option 1 (40 min).**

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill the tank in 5 hours and 8 hours, respectively. Pipe C can empty the same tank in 10 hours. Find the time taken to fill the empty tank when all the pipes are opened simultaneously.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipe A to fill the tank = 5 hours.

Time taken by pipe B to fill the tank = 8 hours.

Time taken by pipe C to empty the tank = 10 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour when all pipes are opened = (Part filled by A in 1 hour) + (Part filled by B in 1 hour) - (Part emptied by C in 1 hour)

**Calculation:**

Part of the tank filled by A in 1 hour = 1/5

Part of the tank filled by B in 1 hour = 1/8

Part of the tank emptied by C in 1 hour = 1/10

Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour:

⇒ (1/5) + (1/8) - (1/10)

⇒ (1)/(5) + (1)/(8) - (1)/(10)

⇒ (8)/(40) + (5)/(40) - (4)/(40)

⇒ (8 + 5 - 4)/(40)

⇒ (9)/(40)

Time taken to fill the tank:

⇒ 1 / (Net part of the tank filled in 1 hour)

⇒ 1 / (9)/(40)

⇒ (40)/(9)

⇒ 4 4/9 hours

**The time taken to fill the empty tank when all the pipes are opened simultaneously is 4 4/9 hours.**

questions.question: The S.I unit of resistance is equivalent to:
questions.solution:
The SI unit of resistance is the ohm (Ω). According to Ohm's Law, the resistance (R) of a conductor is the ratio of the voltage (V) across the conductor to the current (I) flowing through it: 

 

 

R = V / I 

 

The SI unit of voltage (V) is the volt (V), and the SI unit of current (I) is the ampere (A). 

 

Therefore, the SI unit of resistance (ohm) can be expressed in terms of these fundamental units as:

1 ohm (Ω) = 1 volt / 1 ampere (V/A) 

 

Now let's look at the given options:

 
• **Volt/ampere **- This matches our derivation of the SI unit of resistance. 2) joule/coulomb - The SI unit of joule/coulomb is the volt (V), which is the unit of electric potential or voltage. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Coulomb/joule**—This is the inverse of volt, so it is not the unit of resistance.
 
• **Ampere/volt**—This is the inverse of ohm, so it is not the unit of resistance.

Therefore, the SI unit of resistance is equivalent to volt/ampere.

questions.question: World Water Day is celebrated on _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri Mar 22.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Water Day** is celebrated annually on **22nd March**__ to highlight the importance of freshwater and advocate for the sustainable management of freshwater resources.
 
• The day is observed to raise awareness about the 2.2 billion people living without access to safe water.
 
• Each year, World Water Day focuses on a specific aspect of freshwater, with themes such as water and climate change, water scarcity, and water quality.
 
• The United Nations General Assembly designated 22nd March as World Water Day in 1993 following the 1992 United Nations Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED) in Rio de Janeiro.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Water is a critical resource** for human survival, agriculture, industry, and ecosystem health.
 
• The **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, adopted by all United Nations Member States in 2015, include a dedicated goal (SDG 6) to ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
 
• World Water Day is an opportunity to learn more about water-related issues, be inspired to tell others, and take action to make a difference.
 
• The theme for World Water Day 2024 is yet to be announced but will continue to emphasize the importance of water conservation and sustainable practices.

questions.question: In certain store, the profit is 260% of the cost. If the selling price is Rs. 7,200, then the cost price is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 7,200

Profit Percentage = 260% of Cost Price (CP)

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP - CP

Profit = (Profit Percentage / 100) × CP

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price be CP.

Profit = 260% of CP = (260 / 100) × CP

Profit = 2.6 × CP

Selling Price = Cost Price + Profit

7,200 = CP + 2.6 × CP

7,200 = 1 × CP + 2.6 × CP

7,200 = 3.6 × CP

⇒ CP = 7,200 / 3.6

⇒ CP = 2,000

**The cost price is Rs. 2,000.**

questions.question: Rays coming from the sun are refracted by the atmosphere. Due to this, the apparent sunrise is about ________ the actual sunrise.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2 minutes before**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The apparent sunrise occurs about **2 minutes before** the actual sunrise due to atmospheric refraction.
 
• Atmospheric refraction bends the light rays coming from the sun, making the sun appear above the horizon when it is still below it.
 
• This phenomenon causes the sun to be seen earlier than its actual geometric position relative to the horizon.
 
• Similarly, during sunset, the sun is visible for about 2 minutes after it has actually set below the horizon.
 
• This effect is more pronounced at higher latitudes and during certain times of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atmospheric refraction** is the bending of light as it passes through the Earth's atmosphere, which has varying density layers.
 
• This bending of light causes celestial objects to appear higher in the sky than their actual geometric position.
 
• The phenomenon is also responsible for the apparent flattening of the sun's disk near the horizon.
 
• Understanding atmospheric refraction is crucial for accurate astronomical observations and navigation.

questions.question: Solve (a − b)³ + (b − 2c)³ + (−a + 2c)³.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(a − b)³ + (b − 2c)³ + (−a + 2c)³

**Formula used:**

We can apply the identity: x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

Where x = a − b, y = b − 2c, and z = −a + 2c.

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + y + z = (a − b) + (b − 2c) + (−a + 2c)

⇒ = a − b + b − 2c − a + 2c

⇒ = 0

Since x + y + z = 0, by the identity, the entire expression simplifies to:

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

⇒ 3 × (a − b) × (b − 2c) × (−a + 2c)

Thus, the answer is:

**∴ The result is 3 × (a − b) × (b − 2c) × (−a + 2c).**

questions.question: Today, age of the father is twice the sum of the ages of his 3 children. After 15 years father's age will be equal to the sum of the ages of his children. How old is the father 15 years from today?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Father's age today = F

Ages of the three children today = C₁, C₂, C₃

**Formula Used:**

1. F = 2 × (C₁ + C₂ + C₃)

2. F + 15 = (C₁ + 15) + (C₂ + 15) + (C₃ + 15)

**Calculation:**

Let the sum of the ages of the three children today be S.

1. F = 2S

2. F + 15 = S + 45

Substituting F from the first equation into the second equation:

⇒ 2S + 15 = S + 45

⇒ 2S - S = 45 - 15

⇒ S = 30

Now, substituting S back into the first equation:

⇒ F = 2 × 30

⇒ F = 60

Father's age today = 60 years

Father's age 15 years from today = 60 + 15 = 75 years

**The father is 75 years old 15 years from today.**

Percentage increase = [(Size 8 sales - Size 9 sales) / Size 9 sales] × 100

questions.question: What is the full form of UNEP?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Environment Programme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of **UNEP** is **United Nations Environment Programme**.
 
• UNEP is responsible for coordinating the United Nations' environmental activities and assisting developing countries in implementing environmentally sound policies and practices.
 
• It was established as a result of the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in June 1972 and is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
 
• UNEP's mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UNEP's work encompasses a wide range of activities, including climate change, disaster and conflict, ecosystem management, environmental governance, chemicals and waste, resource efficiency, and environment under review.
 
• It collaborates with various stakeholders, including governments, private sector, civil society, and international organizations, to promote sustainable development worldwide.
 
• UNEP plays a crucial role in the implementation of the environmental dimension of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• It also produces key reports such as the Global Environment Outlook (GEO) to provide comprehensive assessments of the state of the global environment.

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement(s) from among the following.

(a) The direction of magnetic field at a point can be found by placing a magnetic compass at that point.

(b) A freely suspended magnetic needle points in north-east direction.

(c) The magnetic field lines are denser near the poles of a magnet.

(d) Two magnetic field lines can intersect at a given point.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**4 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement (a):** The direction of the magnetic field at a point can indeed be found by placing a magnetic compass at that point. The compass needle aligns itself along the magnetic field lines, indicating the direction of the magnetic field.
 
• **Statement (b):** A freely suspended magnetic needle points in the north-south direction, not the north-east direction. This is because the Earth itself acts as a giant magnet, and the needle aligns itself along the Earth's magnetic field lines.
 
• **Statement (c):** The magnetic field lines are indeed denser near the poles of a magnet. This indicates that the magnetic field is stronger near the poles.
 
• **Statement (d):** Two magnetic field lines can never intersect at a given point. If they did, it would imply that the magnetic field has two different directions at that point, which is impossible.

Therefore, the correct statements are (a) and (c), making **option 4**__ the correct answer.
